text: ほら　バイクで　はいって　くんなよ！

structure.jp: はいって　くんなよ！

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な after a plain verb is a blunt 'don't'. くんな is the slurred form of くるな = 'don't come'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる means doing it while coming toward the speaker. はいってくん(な) = '(don't) come in here'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says what is used to do the action. バイクで = 'by bike'.
